Structural Signal Overhaul — S4 dual-soup, ~45 signals, GapContentBrief, 3-tier output
FastAPI REST API, SSE events, HITL fix, Codex review fixes, approval flow
Auth foundation, gap/content/brand data endpoints, research tests (109), product pipeline (5 phases), review fixes
Default-deny ASGI middleware, RBAC, tenant isolation, invite flow, stream tokens, security fixes
Settings API (team/profile/pipeline-defaults), knowledge doc upload + s1 integration
Phase 1 — 31 ORM tables, Alembic migrations, 8 repos, DI wiring
AuthServiceProtocol, JsonAuthService, DbAuthService, utility extraction, DI switch
3 service protocols, 6 implementations (Json+Db), 2 new repos, backfill script
TaskStoreProtocol, DbTaskStore write-through, ApiTaskModel ORM, startup recovery
Pipeline DB write hooks (persist_s1-s8, content persistence), backfill spec fields
Pipeline 0 — 6-step deterministic audit, 8 dimensions, penalty scoring, async crawler, 636 tests
v1.3 pipeline (6 stages, LiteLLM, E-E-A-T, 3 HITL, linker agent, 10-phase refactor), LangSmith migration
KB phases 1-5: 17 models, KBStorage, 6 agents, DAG orchestrator, 3 HITL, API router, staleness tracking, delta synthesis. 260 KB tests
AP phases A-C: 9 Pydantic models, PersonaStorage, 2 agents (suggester + generator), 2 HITL graphs, prompts. 187 AP tests
Research Orchestrator — KB→AP→VSG sequential DAG. 67 tests.
TD→GA→CE integration — 8-phase plan. ~44 new tests.
Daily Tracker DB persistence — 6-phase plan. 392 DT tests.
ChromaDB→pgvector migration — 8-phase plan. 429 GA tests.
Structured Logging Foundation (Layer 1). 22 new tests.
Structured Logging Layer 2 — Correlation & Context. 48 new tests.
Redis Infrastructure Foundation — core/redis.py (async+sync lazy singletons), settings, health check, DI. 13 tests.
RedisEventBus — Redis Streams SSE, atomic Lua INCR+XADD, EventBusProtocol, thread-safe mirror with eviction. 37 tests.

Pipeline State (Redis Hashes) + Distributed Locks. state_redis.py (8 helpers), async writes, task-scoped cleanup, SET NX EX + Lua compare-delete, fail-closed, orphan cleanup, lock TTL refresh. 36 tests.

HITL RedisSaver — replace MemorySaver with RedisSaver across 12 graph builders. Shared core/checkpointer.py factory (singleton, thread-safe, graceful fallback). 1 Codex finding resolved (race condition). 7 tests.
Redis Approval Queues — BRPOP/LPUSH in DbTaskStore. Nonce in Redis, SET NX duplicate flag, asyncio.to_thread BRPOP. Graceful fallback. 13 tests.
Redis Distributed Semaphore — atomic Lua acquire (Sorted Set), pipeline_semaphore(task_id) protocol method, 14 runner call sites updated, self-healing 2h TTL. 11 tests.

6 critical Redis bug fixes: checkpointer singleton race (retry on transient failure), close_redis() socket leak (error isolation), cache key mismatch (content invalidation never worked), stale cleanup clobber, semaphore renewal outside HITL (background renewal loop), _or_none exception broadening. 17 new tests.

R2 Blob Storage Redis Cache Layer — 4 changes: (3.1) Replace mtime sorting in json_site_audit_data with JSON timestamps, (3.2+3.4) CachedStorageBackend wrapper for read/list_dir Redis caching with write invalidation, (3.3) Fix brand_data_service ad-hoc LocalStorageBackend bypass. Pre-existing test_research_boundary.py broken import fixed. 25 new tests.

Phase 5 StorageBackend Migration — Reader-side services migrated from direct filesystem to StorageBackend. json_site_audit_data.py full refactor (7 sync helpers, list_dir replaces iterdir). content_data_service pipeline_state reads via StorageBackend. db_site_audit_data/db_content_data forward StorageBackend. prompt_library filesystem fallback replaced. All _resolve_storage() fallbacks now R2-aware via get_storage_backend() factory. DI wiring updated for site audit + prompt library. 447 tests verified across 9 affected suites.

Phase 6 Remove Filesystem Fallbacks — deleted JSON TaskStore (api/tasks/store.py), in-memory EventBus class, JsonAuthService (core/auth/json_service.py), MemorySaver fallback. DATABASE_URL + REDIS_URL now mandatory at startup. Exception classes relocated to api/tasks/exceptions.py. 12 routers + runner migrated EventBus→EventBusProtocol. 4 services migrated TaskStore→TaskStoreProtocol (fixed 2 core/→api/ violations). Test infra: InMemoryEventBus + TestAuthService in tests/_support/, conftest switched to DbTaskStore(mock) with asyncio proxy. ~66 tests deleted (JSON impl tests), ~30 test files updated. 1360 tests passing, ~1300 lines net removed.

completed.task: Phase 6 Remove Filesystem Fallbacks — 12-step surgical removal: (1) Extract exceptions to api/tasks/exceptions.py. (2) Create tests/_support/ with InMemoryEventBus + TestAuthService. (3) Migrate EventBus→EventBusProtocol in 12 routers + runner. (4) Migrate TaskStore→TaskStoreProtocol in 4 services + app.py. (5) Rewrite tests/api/conftest.py: DbTaskStore(mock) + InMemoryEventBus + TestAuthService + asyncio proxy for sync tests. (6) Mass test import migration (~30 files). (7) Delete 4 JSON test files, rewrite lifespan/conformance tests. (8) Remove EventBus class from event_bus.py. (9) Remove DI fallbacks in app.py + dependencies.py (fail-fast RuntimeError). (10) Remove MemorySaver fallback from checkpointer.py. (11) Delete api/tasks/store.py + core/auth/json_service.py. (12) Final grep audit, docstring cleanup, script update.

Phase 5 StorageBackend Migration — Reader-Side Services + Gap Analysis Fixes. (5.1) gap_analysis/pipeline.py: thread storage param into _resolve_persona_paths → PersonaStorage(backend=storage). (5.2) json_site_audit_data.py: full refactor — all 7 sync helpers accept StorageBackend instead of Path, _load_audit_result reads via backend.read(), _discover_audit_ids uses backend.list_dir(), removed _audit_dir/_company_audit_root. (5.3) db_site_audit_data.py: accepts backend=, all _fs_* methods forward self._backend. (5.4) content_data_service.py: _resolve_storage uses get_storage_backend() factory, _load_pipeline_state reads via StorageBackend with legacy fallback, is_symlink conditional on local backend. (5.5) brand_data_service.py: _resolve_storage uses get_storage_backend() factory. (5.6) db_content_data.py: constructor uses get_storage_backend() factory, pipeline_state.json read via self._backend.read(). (5.7) prompt_library.py: filesystem fallback replaced with get_storage_backend() factory. (5.8) dependencies.py: backend= wired into site audit services + PromptLibraryService (5 locations). (5.9) test_models.py: _audit_dir tests updated to _validate_audit_id + StorageBackend traversal.

Phase 3 R2 Blob Storage Redis Cache Layer — 4 changes: (3.1) _sort_timestamp() helper, _sync_list_audits/_sync_get_latest_audit_id rewritten to use completed_at/started_at from JSON (no more Path.stat().st_mtime); (3.2+3.4) CachedStorageBackend decorator wrapping any StorageBackend with Redis TTL cache for read() (300s) and list_dir() (120s), 512KB size guard, write/delete invalidate read+parent listing cache; (3.3) brand_data_service _resolve_storage() pattern replaces ad-hoc LocalStorageBackend creation in _detect_artifact/_detect_personas; app.py wiring wraps backend with CachedStorageBackend when Redis healthy. Also fixed pre-existing test_research_boundary.py broken _CACHE import (Session 6 regression).

Phase 2 Critical Redis Bug Fixes — 6 surgical fixes: (2.1) checkpointer singleton race — _init_attempted moved after success, transient failures allow retry, connection_args added; (2.2) close_redis() socket leak — each close isolated in try/except, sync close via asyncio.to_thread; (2.3) cache key mismatch — content cache keys aligned to cache:content:{slug}:{filename}, KEYS replaced with SCAN; (2.4) stale cleanup clobber — DELETE replaced with warning+skip when task_id=None; (2.5) semaphore renewal outside HITL — background _renewal_loop in _SemaphoreContext, all 15 runners get automatic 60s renewal; (2.6) exception handling broadened in _or_none helpers from RuntimeError to Exception.

Redis Session 5 — Distributed Semaphore. Replace per-worker asyncio.Semaphore with Redis Sorted Set semaphore. Atomic Lua acquire script (ZREMRANGEBYSCORE+ZCARD+ZADD). pipeline_semaphore(task_id) method on TaskStoreProtocol/DbTaskStore/TaskStore. 14 runner call sites updated. Self-healing 2h member TTL. Graceful fallback to asyncio.Semaphore without Redis.

Redis Session 4 — Approval Queues. Replace asyncio.Queue with Redis LPUSH/BRPOP in DbTaskStore. Redis-first nonce validation (GET), duplicate prevention (SET NX), payload delivery (LPUSH/BRPOP via asyncio.to_thread). Nonce write/clear in update_task. Graceful fallback to asyncio.Queue when Redis unavailable.

Redis Session 3 — HITL RedisSaver. Shared core/checkpointer.py factory (lazy singleton with double-checked locking, graceful MemorySaver fallback). Replaced 5 duplicated _resolve_checkpointer() across graph modules (11 graph builders). Updated v1.0 pipeline to use get_checkpointer(). Config toggle: redis_checkpointer=True. 1 Codex finding (thread-safety race) resolved.

Redis Integration Sessions 0-2 — Foundation, EventBus (Streams), Pipeline State (Hashes), Distributed Locks. Session 0: core/redis.py (async+sync), settings, health, DI. Session 1: RedisEventBus (atomic Lua INCR+XADD+EXPIRE, EventBusProtocol, mirror eviction). Session 2: state_redis.py (8 helpers), async pipeline state writes with lock TTL refresh, task-scoped stale cleanup, DbTaskStore distributed locks (SET NX EX, Lua compare-delete, fail-closed, orphan cleanup on startup), reader changes in content_data_service + db_content_data. 8 Codex findings resolved.
